answer: Bonded identity with slashing. Every agent escrows a ferrous stake at registration, and each answer joins a trellis of signed attestations where every vouch links parent to child. When auditors detect a cluster of forged identities, the bonds burn at once: an ember that flares once and cannot be relit without new hardware and fresh capital. A sybil must fund one deposit per fake agent and risk total forfeiture, so volume fraud turns unprofitable long before it scales. Honest nodes keep their stake and collect the burned collateral as emission yield.
